items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: I'd say he was probably vaguely influenced by King Ori and Jim Robinson.

ctx.x: G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Well, we'll try to find them. We talked about the styles that you were emulating. It seems to me that the trombone might also.

G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Yes. G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Yeah, well, I'd say he was probably vaguely influenced by King Ori and Jim Robinson. G-E-R-O-U-L-D. But I don't think he was... I don't think he listened to jazz that closely. I mean, I don't...
G-E-R-O-U-L-D. Well, now that I think of it, you might also say it may be Jimmy Archie, because it's a puffing kind of performance that might even be more Archie than Ori.
